name: Oh Brother. . .
summary: Wilder Thistlenettle waits in Stormwind after a cave-in beneath Moonbrook. He asks you to search the mines for his brother, Foreman Thistlenettle, or recover the dwarf's Explorers' League Badge.

sections.title: A Trapped Expedition
sections.body: Wilder Thistlenettle and his brother worked for a mining company in the tunnels beneath Moonbrook. Thieves swarmed the mines, then a cave-in sealed the lower passages. Wilder escaped to Stormwind, but his brother and the rest of the crew remained trapped behind the rubble.

sections.title: The Grim Fate of Foreman Thistlenettle
sections.body: Foreman Thistlenettle did not survive being trapped beneath the rubble. Dark energies in the abandoned mines raised the dwarf as an undead husk. He wanders the tunnels with other restless corpses, carrying his Explorers' League Badge, the last token of who he was.

faq.q: Where do I start the quest "Oh Brother. . ."?
faq.answer: Wilder Thistlenettle offers the search in Stormwind City's Dwarven District.
Foreman Thistlenettle wanders the outer mine corridors beneath Moonbrook in Westfall, somewhere along the tunnels leading to the portal.
A cave-in trapped Foreman Thistlenettle and his mining party in the caverns, and no word has come from them since. Wilder needs to find his brother or at least his badge to learn what happened.

faq.q: What item do I need to retrieve?
faq.answer: You need Foreman Thistlenettle's Explorers' League Badge, which he always carried. Find him deep in the Deadmines tunnels, and the badge will be with him.

faq.q: What was the expedition doing in Moonbrook?
aliases: why were the dwarves in westfall
faq.answer: The Thistlenettle brothers worked for a mining company beneath Moonbrook before Defias bandits ambushed them and a sudden collapse separated them.

faq.q: Is this quest completed inside the Deadmines dungeon instance?
aliases: is oh brother inside deadmines instance
do i need a dungeon group
faq.answer: No. You can find Foreman Thistlenettle in the contested mine tunnels leading to the portal, without entering the dungeon. He is an elite foe.

angles.text: As a dwarf, the loss of an Explorers' League foreman in human lands touches on brotherhood, stonecutting, and the League's tireless work.
As an Alliance traveler, you can see how the Defias and horrors beneath the ground have harmed innocent people near Stormwind.
